mapper.select: SELECT ec.course_id, ec.id AS class_id, ec.name AS class_name, 'ENROLLED' AS status, NULL AS order_id FROM class_student cs JOIN edu_class ec ON ec.id = cs.class_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED' AND ec.status IN ('ENROLLING', 'IN_PROGRESS') UNION ALL SELECT ec.course_id, ec.id AS class_id, ec.name AS class_name, 'PENDING' AS status, eo.id AS order_id FROM enrollment_order eo JOIN edu_class ec ON ec.id = eo.class_id WHERE eo.student_id = #{studentId} AND eo.status = 'PENDING' AND eo.expire_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
